patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in hr, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Same category, different company size. Choose Gusto only if your buying job matches “US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Pre” rather than Workday's shape. Choose Workday only if your buying job matches “Enterprise HCM default — custom PEPM quote (no published seat $); implementation-led. Land” rather than Gusto's shape. Workflow advantage: Gusto leans payroll-benefits, core-hris; Workday leans enterprise-hcm. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in hr, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Gusto is US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Premium $180 + $22.; Workday is Enterprise HCM default — custom PEPM quote (no published seat $); implementation-led. Landscape only vs SMB HRIS/payroll..
- Company-size focus: Gusto (micro, small-business) vs Workday (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gusto-leaning payroll-benefits, core-hris vs Workday-leaning enterprise-hcm.
- Researched limits: Gusto — Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; Workday — No published list price — PEPM and implementation are opaque.

Limitations — Gusto: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; People/HRIS depth is light versus BambooHR; Gusto is payroll-first; Workday: No published list price — PEPM and implementation are opaque; Multi-month implementations and SI partners are typical.

Poor-fit cases: Gusto is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus · Workday is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No published list price — PEPM and implementation are opaque · Avoid Gusto if you actually need Workday's motion (Enterprise HCM default — custom PEPM quote (no published seat $); implementation)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
